scope: Five retained critical-window contact-composition iterations before the accepted v6 audit
summary: v1 through v5 progressively established two-hand visibility, support contact, and smaller human residuals, but every candidate still failed the complete-human-removal proxy and remained unaccepted.
evidence: v1 failed human removal, support contact, and two-hand visibility.
v2 passed two hands but failed human removal and support contact.
v3-v5 passed both contact proxies and two hands but retained a source-skin component as large as 398 pixels.
All five manifests remain immutable under output directories 032000Z through 037000Z.
lessons: Conjunctive gates prevented progressive proxy improvements from being mistaken for acceptance.
Component-level residual audits are more diagnostic than mean skin similarity.
limitations: The v1-v5 human-residue metric was still a proxy and required semantic review.
next_actions: Remove the localized residual without changing flower or hand geometry, then rerun the same gates.
